// Initial two-line tool scaffold is uncredited bootstrap work.
fn main() {}

scope: Authenticated package SOURCE identity and owned verified bytes. This is not checked code, a Cargo resolver or package runtime authority.
static_review: independent core review found no substitution/TOCTOU integrity gap; bounded reads changed to pinned length plus one byte
independent producer review found trailing archive framing risk; strict fully consumed framing plus recomputed-checksum controls reject it
Independent final audit reconstructed the first two transactions and found the allocation comment too strong; the third transaction clarifies only that comment and preserves identical checked IR.
Independent review required trusted expected pins outside untrusted envelope storage. v5 separates capabilities; the deployed catalog was migrated only after the final v6 native controls.

Independent review required header authentication before trusting its payload length. v6 adds an owned-file reader through reuse::AuthenticatedRoot, exact authenticated-length reads plus EOF probe, owned-payload verification before manifest parsing, and expected identity/edge matching. Final external audit remains separately reported by the parent.

comment_only_correction.measured_run_scope: Historical runs preceding v4 remain bound to their recorded earlier snapshots. Later catalog-split and authenticated-envelope phases below name their actual v5/v6 source snapshots.
comment_only_correction.query: Authenticated prior snapshot for an unchanged target file; current file SHA matched the queried file SHA and edit checked the current complete source snapshot.
comment_only_correction.reason: The bound concerns bytes read and retained, not exact Vec allocation capacity.
